posts.title: Quake Engine Black Book
posts.description: It looks like Fabien Sanglard is writing a Quake Engine Black Book . posts.title: Quake Rally Archive
posts.description: I’ve developed some new Quake archive projects. The first is a Quake Rally archive: Quake Rally Archive This includes all releases of Quake Rally, all third-party maps, and even precursor mods and extension mods.
